For Reviewers

The rubrics.

11 rubrics · four levels · every criterion mapped to the outcomes

The made response (the Canon)made-response

An essay, short film, recorded piece, or designed object answering a text, film, and album, defended in seminar.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
ReadingBreadth of MindSummarizes the text; the argument is not yet reconstructed.Reconstructs the argument with gaps or a misreading.Reconstructs the argument accurately, with evidence from the text.Reconstructs it as its author would, and finds what it leaves unsaid.
The connectionJudgment · Breadth of MindPlaces the three works side by side without joining them.Names a connection that rests on one of the three.Defends one idea across text, film, and album with evidence from each.Makes the three works illuminate each other in a way a reader had not seen.
The makingWorkmanshipThe response is unfinished or does not stand without its maker.It is finished; the form fights the idea.It is finished, and the form carries the idea.The form is the argument; it could not have been made another way.
The defenseArticulationCannot yet say what the work claims.States the claim; questions knock it over.States and holds the claim under seminar questions.Uses the questions to sharpen the claim in the room.
The quantitative study (Mathematics and Science)quantitative-study

A real motion, sound, image, wave, board, or forecast, measured, modeled, and defended.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
MeasurementJudgment · WorkmanshipData are missing, borrowed, or uncollected.Data are collected; method and error are not stated.Data are collected with a stated method and an estimate of error.The measurement is designed so its error can be bounded and checked.
The modelJudgmentA formula is applied without showing why it fits.The model fits the data; its assumptions are unstated.The model fits, its assumptions are stated, and the fit is shown.The model's limits are found by testing where it breaks.
The mathematicsJudgmentSteps contain errors that change the result.Steps are correct with minor slips.Steps are correct and each is justified.The mathematics is economical and chosen for the physics.
Physical before formalBreadth of Mind · WorkmanshipThe notation stands alone; the physical thing is absent.The physical thing is named but not used.Every quantity is tied to something that can be seen or felt.A reader without the notation could follow the argument from the physical thing.
The defenseArticulationCannot explain the setup.Explains the answer, not the setup.Explains the setup and the answer, and takes questions.Anticipates the strongest objection and answers it first.
The working system (Computation and Engineering)working-system

A program, model, instrument, or autonomous system that runs, with its verification and failure analysis.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
It worksWorkmanshipIt does not run, or runs only in the maker's hands.It runs on the demonstrated case.It runs on cases the maker did not choose.It runs in the world, under conditions it was not tuned for.
Direction and verificationCommand of Intelligence · JudgmentMachine-written work is accepted unread.Machine-written work is read but not tested.Every delegated piece is specified, tested, and logged.The verification would catch a subtle error a reviewer planted.
Failure analysisJudgmentFailures are not reported.Failures are listed without causes.Each failure has a cause and a consequence.The analysis predicts failures not yet seen.
MeasurementJudgment · WorkmanshipClaims of speed, accuracy, or reliability are unmeasured.Measured once, without a baseline.Measured against a baseline, with method stated.Measured so another builder could reproduce the number.
The accountArticulationA reader cannot tell what the system does.A reader can tell what it does, not why it is built so.A reader can tell what, why, and what was traded away.The account would let a stranger maintain it.
The writing portfolio (Rhetoric)writing-portfolio

Revised essays, first drafts beside finals, line-edited.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
The claimJudgment · ArticulationNo claim can be found.A claim is present but hedged into nothing.A single claim, stated early, holds the essay together.The claim is one a reasonable reader resists, and earns its place.
EvidenceJudgmentAssertion without support.Support that is general or borrowed.Particular evidence, rightly placed.Evidence chosen so the reader sees it before being told.
The sentenceArticulationSentences obscure their meaning.Clear, with padding and abstraction.Plain, short, and exact; every sentence does work.The prose has a voice and nothing to cut.
RevisionArticulation · WorkmanshipThe final repeats the draft.Marks were answered one by one; the essay is the same.The final is a different, better essay than the draft.The distance between draft and final teaches something about writing.
The forensic teardown (Epistemics)forensic-teardown

A documented teardown of a real piece of persuasion, defended against a persuader's advocate.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
The claimsJudgmentThe piece is described, not dismantled.Main claims are listed; their kinds are not.Every claim is listed and tagged by kind and evidence.Implied claims are surfaced and tagged as well.
The techniquesJudgment · Command of IntelligenceTechniques are named loosely.Techniques are named and located.Each technique is named, located, and its effect explained.The design of the whole is reconstructed from its parts.
The truth of the matterJudgmentThe verdict rests on opinion.The verdict rests on one source.Each claim is checked against sources a skeptic would accept.Where the truth cannot be settled, the uncertainty is stated and bounded.
SourcesJudgment · ArticulationSources are missing.Sources are listed without assessment.Each source is assessed for who made it and why.The source trail would survive an adversarial review.
The cultural artifact (Culture and Signal)cultural-artifact

A track, a piece of video, a field study, or a shipped artifact that reaches a real audience, with the numbers.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
Made and shippedWorkmanshipNot released.Released where no one could find it.Released through a real channel on a stated date.Released through channels chosen for the audience it was made for.
The numbersJudgmentNo numbers, or vanity numbers alone.Numbers without denominators.Numbers with denominators, and what they measure stated.The numbers are read against a prediction made before release.
The accountArticulationA diary of what happened.An account of what happened and in what order.An account of why it moved, or did not.An account another maker could use.
The sceneBreadth of MindThe work is unplaced.The work names its influences.The work is placed in a scene and its history.The work adds something its scene had not yet said.
The shipped build (the Workshop)shipped-build

The semester's build, exhibited in public.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
It shipsWorkmanshipNot finished.Finished; parts are held by intention, not construction.Finished, works, and survives handling by a stranger.Finished to a standard the maker can name and has met.
The briefJudgmentNo brief, or the brief changed without notice.A brief, loosely met.The brief, met; changes to it were made openly.The brief, met; and the client would hire the team again.
DocumentationArticulationNo record.Photographs without notes.Drawings, decisions, and failures recorded as the work went.Another team could build it again from the record.
CritiqueJudgment · ArticulationDefends rather than describes.Hears critique; changes nothing.Describes before judging, and makes the one change.Runs a critique that improves someone else's work.
The studio work (the Depths)studio-work

A finished studio piece, used, screened, released, or installed before a real audience.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
The briefJudgmentThe project drifts.The brief is met in part.The brief is met, and its constraints shaped the work.The constraints were turned into the work's strength.
TechniqueWorkmanship · Command of IntelligenceThe technique is visible as struggle.Competent, with uneven passages.Controlled throughout.Technique disappears into the work.
The audienceJudgment · WorkmanshipNever met an audience.Shown; reactions not recorded.Shown, observed, and changed by what was observed.Designed from observation and proven in front of strangers.
TasteJudgment · Breadth of MindChoices are defaults.Choices are made, not defended.Choices are made and defended against alternatives.Choices are defended against the tradition the work belongs to.
The field report (the Field Term)field-report

The written field report, the field journal, and the mentor's evaluation.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
The work doneWorkmanshipResponsibilities unmet.Responsibilities met with supervision.Responsibilities met independently.The organization relied on the work.
Judgment in the fieldJudgmentDecisions deferred.Decisions made, not explained.Decisions made and explained in the journal.Decisions the mentor would have made, and some they would not have thought of.
The reportArticulationA log of tasks.An account of the work.An account of what the work taught, with evidence.An account the organization would publish.
Self-assessmentJudgment · ArticulationAbsent.Generous to the self.Agrees with the mentor's evaluation, with reasons.Sees what the mentor missed, both ways.
The capstone (the defended original work)capstone

A research thesis, an engineered system that works, or a venture that exists, defended in public.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
OriginalJudgment · Breadth of MindRestates existing work.Applies existing work to a new case.Contributes something that did not exist.Contributes something others will build on.
It existsWorkmanship · Command of IntelligencePlans and fragments.A working core with gaps.{'Complete in its form': 'argued, running, or trading.'}Complete, and tested against the world.
MethodJudgment · Command of IntelligenceMethod is unstated.Method is stated, loosely followed.Method fits the question and is followed.Method would satisfy an outside examiner in the field.
The defenseArticulationCannot defend the central claim.Defends the claim against friendly questions.Defends it against outside examiners.Concedes what should be conceded, and holds the rest.
Against the four yearsBreadth of MindStands alone.Mentions earlier work.Draws on the Canon, the mathematics, and the Workshop by name.Shows the four years as one argument that ends here.
The unassisted examination (every course)unassisted-examination

Periodic examinations in writing, mathematics, and code, with every tool closed.

CriterionBeginningDevelopingProficientMastered
AccuracyJudgmentErrors that change the result.Correct with slips.Correct throughout.Correct, and checked by an independent route.
SetupJudgmentThe problem is not set up.Set up with prompting.Set up from words, unaided.Set up the simplest way, with the reason given.
ExpressionArticulationThe answer cannot be followed.The answer can be followed with effort.The answer is plain and complete.The answer would teach the reader.
Status

A working framework, not an authorized degree. SDIT is in its founding phase and is not yet authorized to grant degrees; where authorization stands is published in full. The curriculum is open and free to take.
